serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hello Annalie, how are you?
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Oh, hi!
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: I’m fine thanks for asking!
Lady Annalie: As you can see, my shop is also doing fine. In part because of you!
You: Don’t mention it.
Lady Annalie: There’s still much work to do, especially on the financial part and it will take me forever to bounce back, but I’m happy the shop is open once again!
You: Me too.
